message.content: Use no tools. Write a 200-word story about a lighthouse keeper, in plain prose.

content.text:
Marta climbed the two hundred steps every dusk, as her father had, and his father before him. The lamp at the top was old, but she kept the brass bright and the lens clean.

Tonight the fog came in thick. She lit the lamp and watched the beam turn slowly through the white air. It reached only a short way before the fog swallowed it.

Near midnight she heard a horn far out on the water. It was faint, and it sounded lost. She rang the bell by the door, one slow stroke every half minute. The horn came closer. It answered her, weak and then stronger.

She rang the bell for four hours. Her arm ached, and her hands went numb with cold.

At last a fishing boat slid out of the fog. A man stood at the bow and raised one hand toward the tower. Marta did not wave back. She kept ringing until the boat passed the rocks and reached the calm water of the harbor.

Then she set down the rope and sat on the cold stone floor. Below her, the sea went on breathing in the dark. In the east, the sky began to turn grey.

She climbed down slowly, and she made tea.
